statement:
∀ (a b : ℝ),
  0 < a →
    0 < b →
      Real.Gamma a * Real.Gamma b =
        ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioi 0, p.1 ^ (a - 1) * rexp (-p.1) * (p.2 ^ (b - 1) * rexp (-p.2))
